annotations.title: Generate a link page QR code

description: Generate a crisp, scannable SVG QR code for a link page’s public address (or verified Pro custom domain), styled with the page’s theme and brand colours or high-contrast black on white. Returns the SVG markup, target URL, colours and suggested filename. Changes nothing.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

size.description: Output SVG width and height in pixels, from 128 to 1024. Defaults to 512.

useBrandColors.description: true styles the QR code with the link page’s theme and brand colours (default); false returns high-contrast black on white for printing.

name: links_qr
title: Generate a link page QR code
